primary.description: Make this the primary Gateway, used in the chart context. Only 1 Gateway can be primary.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Gateway. Defaults to the release namespace.

nameOverride.description: Suffix of the Gateway name, instead of the key of the object.

gatewayClassName.description: Name of the GatewayClass the Gateway uses.

targetSelector.description: Key of a `gatewayClass` object of this chart. Its name is used as `gatewayClassName`.

type.description: Type of the address, like `IPAddress` or `Hostname`. Defaults to `IPAddress` in Gateway API.

value.description: The address value, like an IP address or a hostname.

items.description: A requested address for the gateway.

addresses.description: Requested addresses of the Gateway, passed on as is.

infrastructure.description: Infrastructure settings of the Gateway, passed on as is.

annotations.description: Annotations for the resources created for the Gateway.

labels.description: Labels for the resources created for the Gateway.

group.description: API group of the parameters resource.

parametersRef.description: Implementation specific parameters of the gateway.

from.description: Where ListenerSets can attach from: `All`, `Same`, `Selector` or `None`.

selector.description: Label selector of the namespaces, used with `from: Selector`.

namespaces.description: Namespaces from which ListenerSets can attach.

allowedListeners.description: Which ListenerSets can attach to the Gateway.

tls.description: TLS settings that apply to the whole Gateway, passed on as is.

frontend.description: TLS settings for connections from clients, passed on as is.

additionalProperties.description: A setting passed on as is.

backend.description: TLS settings for connections to backends, passed on as is.

additionalProperties.description: A setting passed on as is.

items.description: A listener of the Gateway, see [Gateway](/truecharts-common/gateway).

listeners.description: Listeners of the Gateway. Each one needs a `name`, `port` and `protocol`, see [listener](/truecharts-common/gateway).

description: Gateways, keyed by name. Every enabled entry renders a Gateway API `Gateway`, see [Gateway](/truecharts-common/gateway).
